title: [HR] HR Administrator, On-site in Irvine, CA
description:
Position Summary:

TCL North America is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and service-minded HR Administrator to support the day-to-day operations of the Human Resources function. This role provides hands-on administrative support across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee records, HRIS administration, payroll and benefits coordination, compliance documentation, employee communications, and general HR operations.

The HR Administrator will work closely with the HR team and cross-functional partners to ensure HR processes are completed accurately, timely, and confidentially. This position will also provide general office and administrative support, including employee events, meetings, visitors, and workplace coordination.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys being hands-on, takes pride in accuracy and follow-through, communicates professionally, and is comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced corporate environment. This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who wants broad exposure to HR operations and the opportunity to develop across areas such as HR administration, payroll, benefits, compliance, onboarding, and employee experience.

Duties & Responsibilities:

HR Administration & Operations

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the HR team across onboarding, employee records, payroll, benefits, compliance, employee engagement, and general HR operations.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee information in the HRIS and other HR systems.
  • Maintain organized personnel files, employee documentation, forms, trackers, reports, and HR records in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.
  • Support employee lifecycle activities, including new hires, transfers, promotions, status changes, leaves, terminations, and offboarding.
  • Prepare and process routine HR documentation, employee forms, policy acknowledgments, and other required paperwork.
  • Assist with HR reporting, audits, compliance activities, and recurring HR processes.
  • Respond to routine employee questions and requests, providing information when appropriate and escalating matters to the appropriate HR team member when needed.
  • Support HR projects, process improvements, and other administrative initiatives as assigned.
  • Maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion when handling employee information.

Payroll & Benefits Support

  • Support payroll administration by maintaining accurate employee data and coordinating payroll-related updates and documentation.
  • Assist with payroll changes, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, deductions, direct deposit updates, and other employee data changes.
  • Follow up on timesheets, missing information, and payroll discrepancies in coordination with Payroll, Finance, and HR.
  • Respond to routine payroll-related employee questions and coordinate with the appropriate internal or external resource as needed.
  • Assist with benefits administration, including new hire enrollments, eligibility tracking, employee changes, documentation, and employee communications.
  • Support annual open enrollment activities, including communications, meeting coordination, benefits materials, employee follow-up, and tracking.
  • Assist with documentation related to leave, disability, workers' compensation, and other employee benefit programs as directed.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality when handling payroll, compensation, benefits, leave, and other sensitive employee information.

Onboarding & Employee Lifecycle Support

  • Coordinate administrative aspects of new hire onboarding, including paperwork, HRIS setup, communications, orientation materials, and first-day logistics.
  • Partner with IT, Facilities, Payroll, Benefits, hiring managers, and other departments to ensure new hires have the information, access, equipment, and resources needed to get started successfully.
  • Assist with background checks, I-9 documentation, new hire forms, policy acknowledgments, and other onboarding requirements.
  • Support employee status changes and ensure appropriate HR, payroll, benefits, and internal records are updated.
  • Coordinate administrative aspects of employee offboarding, including documentation, system updates, exit process logistics, and follow-up.
  • Maintain organized and accurate records throughout the employee lifecycle.

Office & Administrative Support

  • Provide general office and administrative support, including greeting visitors, guest check-in, answering calls, mail distribution, office supplies, and shared workspace organization.
  • Coordinate meeting rooms, conference room setup, office lunches, HR meetings, employee meetings, and internal events as needed.
  • Support workplace readiness, office safety procedures, facilities requests, maintenance coordination, and vendor visits.
  • Assist with employee events, meetings, training sessions, and other company activities.
  • Provide additional administrative support to the HR team and office as needed.

Employee Experience & Communication

  • Support employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, HR events, training activities, and employee experience programs.
  • Assist with drafting, formatting, and distributing HR communications, reminders, announcements, and employee resources.
  • Help ensure HR communications and employee-facing materials are clear, professional, timely, and consistent.
  • Provide a friendly, approachable, and professional HR presence for employees and visitors.
  • Handle employee information and interactions with appropriate discretion, professionalism, and judgment.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security. 

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

  • This is an on-site position based in Irvine, CA. Regular in-person attendance is an essential function of the role. 
  • Occasional travel may be required to support retail meetings, industry research, or internal planning sessions.
  • Typical office environment with extended periods of computer-based analytical work. Frequent application of professional judgement aligned with company policies and strategic priorities, learning and utilizing new data platforms and analytical tools. 

Qualifications:

Required/Must Haves

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in HR administration, HR coordination, payroll support, benefits administration, recruiting coordination, office administration, or a related administrative role.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional and service-oriented approach.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience working with HRIS, ATS, payroll, benefits, or other employee record systems preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with employees, candidates, managers, vendors, and cross-functional partners at all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, identify what needs to be done, and follow tasks through to completion.
  • Flexible and willing to support a broad range of HR and administrative responsibilities.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience supporting payroll administration or payroll-related employee data changes.
  • Experience supporting benefits administration, open enrollment, or employee benefits inquiries.
  • Experience with onboarding, employee records, I-9s, background checks, or other employment documentation.
  • Experience supporting recruiting or interview coordination.
  • Familiarity with HR compliance processes and personnel file requirements.
  • Experience working in a corporate office environment.
  • Experience supporting employee events, engagement programs, training, or internal communications.
  • Experience with an HRIS such as Workday, UKG, ADP, Paycom, BambooHR, or similar systems.
  • Interest in developing a broader career in HR, including HR Operations, HR Generalist, Payroll/Benefits, Talent Acquisition, or HR Business Partner support.

The anticipated base salary range for this position ranges from $24.00 - $27.00 hourly. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including skills, experience, education, training, certifications, and business needs.

title: [HVAC / CUSTOMER ADVOCACY] HVAC Technical and Field Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

TCL North America is seeking a resourceful and customer-focused HVAC Technical & Field Support Specialist to join our growing support team. This role plays a critical part in elevating the customer and partner experience by resolving complex technical issues, strengthening field capabilities, and driving continuous product and service improvements across TCL's HVAC and consumer electronics portfolio.

As a key bridge between customers, field partners, and internal engineering teams, this individual will lead advanced troubleshooting efforts, support technical training initiatives, and contribute to root cause analysis and product feedback loops. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on technical expertise, structured problem-solving skills, and a proactive, service-oriented mindset.

This role requires a high level of ownership, comfort operating independently in field environments, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Technical Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide advanced technical support across multiple channels, resolving complex product and service-related issues with a strong focus on customer satisfaction
  • Own and manage technical escalations, including Level 1 and Level 2 troubleshooting across HVAC and consumer electronics product lines
  • Support contractors, distributors, and partners with diagnostics, repair strategies, and resolution of high-complexity field issues

Field Training & Partner Enablement

  • Travel to customer, contractor, and distributor sites to deliver technical training on product usage, system operation, troubleshooting, and repair best practices.
  • Act as a key technical resource to strengthen partner capabilities and ensure consistent service quality across the network.
  • Support field teams with real-time guidance to improve resolution rates and reduce repeat service calls.

Claims Management & Service Operations

  • Review and process customer labor and parts claims, applying data-driven decision-making to approvals and denials.
  • Assist with parts and unit inventory management to maintain optimal service levels and minimize downtime.
  • Ensure adherence to service policies, procedures, and operational standards across all support activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Root Cause Analysis

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to resolve technical issues and identify root causes.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of recurring or emerging product issues, providing actionable feedback to product and engineering teams.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying trends and recommending process or product enhancements.

Knowledge Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned TCL product lines and related technologies.
  • Develop and refine troubleshooting guides, service documentation, and technical workflows to improve efficiency and resolution consistency.
  • Analyze service data and performance metrics to generate insights that inform technical decisions and operational improvements.

Travel & Operational Flexibility

  • Maintain flexibility to support business needs outside of standard working hours, including weekends and holidays as required.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security. 

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

Working Conditions:

  • This is a primarily on-site position based in Irvine, CA and does require regular travel to customer, contractor, distributor, and partner locations.
  • Work may occur in office, warehouse, commercial, and residential environments, including HVAC service and installation areas.
  • Occasional travel and work outside of standard business hours, including weekends and holidays, may be required to support business and customer needs.
  • Work environments may vary and can include exposure to varying temperatures, noise, confined or equipment-access areas, and active service or repair environments.

Cognitive and Physical Demands:

  • Daily: Extended periods of computer work, technical analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, communication with customers and partners, and management of multiple priorities.
  • Frequent: Application of independent judgment to diagnose complex technical issues; interpretation of technical information, service data, and equipment conditions; clear communication of technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Frequent: Standing, walking, and moving throughout field and service environments; occasional bending, reaching, climbing, and positioning to inspect or troubleshoot HVAC equipment and related systems.
  • Occasional: Handling or moving tools, equipment, parts, or product components; working in varying environmental conditions while supporting field training, diagnostics, or service activities.

Qualifications:

Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field (Engineering, IT, or related) or equivalent hands-on experience
  • 4+ years of experience in technical support, field service, or troubleshooting within HVAC, consumer electronics, or related industries
  • Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues independently
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience working cross-functionally in fast-paced, matrixed environments
  • Strong customer service mindset with a focus on continuous improvement
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs
  • Must be locally based and available for onsite and field support

Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on HVAC experience or exposure to HVAC systems, installation, or service operations
  • HVAC certification or progress toward certifications such as EPA Section 608 or C-20 Warm-Air Heating Ventilating and Air-Conditioning Contractor License
  • Experience supporting field service networks, contractors, or technical training programs
  • Familiarity with service operations tools (ERP, CRM, inventory, or ticketing systems)
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive operational improvements

title: [MARKETING] Senior Manager, TCL Mobile Field Marketing & Sales Enablement
description:
Position Summary:

TCL North America is seeking a Senior Manager, Field Marketing & Sales Enablement to lead field marketing strategy, retail sales enablement, and retail advocacy programs for TCL's Mobile business across North America. This role is responsible for driving retail execution, strengthening product knowledge and sales advocacy, optimizing field coverage, and improving sell-out performance across key wireless carriers and national retail partners.

The position serves as the primary business owner for TCL Mobile's third-party field marketing agency, overseeing program strategy, staffing and coverage plans, performance management, budget allocation, and return on investment. This individual will establish program objectives and performance metrics, evaluate field execution through regular market visits, and hold external agency partners accountable for delivering measurable business results.

In addition, this role owns TCL Academy, TCL Mobile's retail training and advocacy platform, including platform management, content effectiveness, user engagement, sales incentive performance, reporting, and fraud prevention. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, vendor management experience, and hands-on knowledge of wireless retail channels to translate business priorities into effective field execution and sustainable sales growth.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Field Marketing Strategy & Retail Execution

  • Field Strategy & Program Planning: Develop annual and quarterly field marketing strategies aligned with TCL Mobile's sales objectives, channel priorities, product launches, promotional campaigns, and broader business goals.
  • Market Coverage & Resource Allocation: Translate wireless carrier and national retail partner priorities into market coverage plans, store prioritization, field staffing requirements, launch support, and retail training initiatives.
  • Retail Execution & Sell-Out Performance: Monitor field activities, store-level execution, product visibility, sales performance, and retail engagement to identify opportunities to improve sell-out and strengthen TCL Mobile's retail presence.
  • KPI Development & Performance Management: Establish and maintain field performance scorecards, program KPIs, and reporting standards to evaluate productivity, market coverage, retail execution, and business impact.
  • Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Gather competitive intelligence, retailer feedback, field observations, and market trends to identify business opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to Sales, Channel Marketing, Product, and leadership teams.
  • Product Launch & Promotional Support: Coordinate field execution priorities for new product introductions, promotional campaigns, and other key commercial initiatives to ensure retail teams have the knowledge, resources, and support needed to represent TCL Mobile effectively.

Third-Party Agency Management & Governance

  • Agency Relationship Management: Serve as the primary business owner for TCL Mobile's third-party field marketing agency, establishing program objectives, service expectations, staffing requirements, operating standards, and performance expectations.
  • Agency Performance & Accountability: Monitor agency performance against agreed-upon KPIs, service levels, staffing plans, and execution standards. Partner with agency leadership to address performance gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Field Workforce Oversight: Hold agency leadership accountable for recruiting, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, employee retention, and timely replacement of field personnel in accordance with contractual expectations.
  • Operating Reviews & Business Planning: Lead regular operating reviews and quarterly business reviews covering field performance, staffing, market coverage, budget utilization, business risks, and improvement plans.
  • Territory & Coverage Optimization: Partner with agency leadership to evaluate territory design, store coverage, market prioritization, and resource allocation based on sales potential, retail partner needs, and program effectiveness.
  • Vendor Governance & Cross-Functional Coordination: Maintain clear accountability between TCL's program oversight responsibilities and the agency's employment and personnel management responsibilities. Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders on vendor governance and contractual requirements.

Market Visits, Field Evaluation & Continuous Improvement

  • Market Visits & Store Audits: Conduct regular market visits, ride-alongs, and retail store audits to evaluate field personnel effectiveness, product knowledge, selling capabilities, retailer relationships, merchandising, and training quality.
  • Execution Validation: Independently validate agency reporting and field activity through firsthand observations, store-level assessments, and performance data analysis.
  • Performance Gap Identification: Document field execution gaps, identify root causes, and work with agency leadership and internal stakeholders to develop and implement corrective action plans.
  • Best Practice Development: Identify successful approaches in high-performing markets and develop recommendations to improve consistency, productivity, and retail execution across supported locations.
  • Field Feedback & Program Optimization: Translate observations from store visits and field personnel into actionable recommendations for product training, sales messaging, promotional execution, and future program planning.

Budget Management, Vendor Evaluation & ROI

  • Budget & Investment Management: Manage the approved TCL Mobile field marketing budget, monitor spending against plan, and recommend resource allocation based on business priorities, market potential, and measurable performance.
  • Program Effectiveness & ROI Analysis: Evaluate the effectiveness of field marketing investments using supported-versus-unsupported market comparisons, sell-out trends, store performance, retail execution, advocacy, and other agreed-upon business metrics.
  • Market Coverage & Cost Analysis: Assess field coverage, staffing models, program costs, and market performance to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and maximize return on investment.
  • Competitive Benchmarking: Benchmark TCL Mobile's field marketing capabilities, retail coverage, program costs, and execution practices against competitors and relevant industry standards.
  • Agency Evaluation & Sourcing Support: Periodically assess alternative third-party field marketing providers and operating models. Support RFPs, vendor evaluations, scopes of work, contract renewals, and vendor selection in partnership with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.
  • Financial Reporting & Recommendations: Prepare program performance and budget reports, identify investment risks or opportunities, and present data-driven recommendations to leadership regarding program structure, market coverage, and resource requirements.

TCL Academy, Retail Training & Sales Advocacy

  • Platform Ownership & Vendor Management: Own TCL Academy's strategy and ongoing performance as TCL Mobile's retail training and advocacy platform, including management of the third-party learning management system (LMS) or SaaS provider, service levels, platform capabilities, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  • User Acquisition & Engagement: Develop and implement initiatives to grow verified membership, active users, repeat participation, and engagement through relevant training content, product launches, contests, and sales incentive programs.
  • Training Content & Calendar Management: Partner with Product, Sales, and Channel Marketing to maintain a timely content calendar supporting TCL Mobile products, promotions, competitive selling, and key retail initiatives.
  • Platform Performance Reporting: Develop and maintain dashboards to monitor membership growth, active users, training participation, content engagement, course completion, user retention, sales submissions, incentive performance, and other platform health metrics.
  • Sales Incentive Program Management: Monitor retail sales incentive and submit-a-sale programs to evaluate participation, performance, cost effectiveness, and contribution to sales objectives.
  • Fraud Prevention & Program Controls: Establish and maintain controls to identify duplicate accounts, invalid sales submissions, unusual activity, and potential fraud or abuse. Coordinate investigation, validation, and remediation with appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
  • Platform Optimization & ROI: Analyze platform performance, training effectiveness, user behavior, and incentive outcomes to recommend improvements that strengthen retail advocacy, improve product knowledge, increase participation, and support measurable sales results.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Business Support

  • Partner with TCL Mobile Sales, Channel Marketing, Product, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and other stakeholders to align field marketing and retail advocacy programs with business priorities.
  • Translate commercial objectives and product strategies into actionable field execution plans, training initiatives, and measurable performance expectations.
  • Provide leadership with timely updates on field performance, agency execution, retail trends, budget utilization, program risks, and recommended actions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, operational efficiency, vendor accountability, platform performance, and overall program effectiveness.
  • Support other TCL Mobile commercial initiatives, business reviews, and special projects as assigned.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security. 

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

Working Conditions

  • This position is on site in Irvine, CA., and regular in-person attendance is an essential function to the role. 
  • The position requires regular travel, up to 40%, for market visits, retail audits, field ride-alongs, carrier and retail partner meetings, agency business reviews, and industry events.
  • Work includes a combination of office-based planning and analysis, virtual and in-person vendor management, and hands-on field evaluation in retail environments.
  • The role requires regular use of computers, reporting systems, analytics tools, presentation software, and the TCL Academy platform.
  • Work schedules may occasionally require flexibility to accommodate retail partner needs, product launches, promotional activities, and business meetings across different markets and time zones.

Cognitive and Physical Demands

  • Daily: Extended periods of computer work, data analysis, reporting, strategic planning, vendor communication, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Frequent: Reviewing performance metrics, evaluating financial and operational information, preparing presentations, exercising professional judgment, and managing competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Frequent: Communicating with agency leadership, retail partners, internal stakeholders, and field personnel to evaluate execution, resolve issues, and implement improvement plans.
  • Periodic: Travel to retail stores, field locations, partner meetings, and industry events; walking and standing during store audits and field evaluations may be required.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business priorities, evaluate complex information, make sound decisions, and drive issues through to resolution.

Qualifications:

Must Have:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Management, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and directly relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in field marketing, retail sales, channel marketing, sales enablement, retail operations, or a related commercial function.
  • Experience working with national retailers, wireless carriers, retail field organizations, or similarly complex channel partner environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing KPIs, scorecards, and performance reporting, with the ability to analyze sales and operational data and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience managing program budgets, evaluating business performance, and making data-driven decisions regarding resource allocation and investment effectiveness.
  • Proven ability to manage external vendors or agency partners, establish performance expectations, monitor execution, and drive accountability without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong understanding of retail execution, field workforce effectiveness, sales enablement, product training, and channel marketing principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience developing dashboards, analyzing performance trends, and preparing management-level reports and presentations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to identify performance gaps, evaluate root causes, and drive corrective actions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, operational, and corporate functions.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, exercise sound business judgment, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 40%, including market visits, partner meetings, agency business reviews, and industry events.

Nice to Have:

  • MBA or other relevant graduate degree.
  • 3+ years of direct experience managing an outsourced field marketing organization, third-party agency, 3PL, or other significant external vendor relationship, including performance and budget accountability.
  • Experience conducting RFPs, agency reviews, vendor selection, contract negotiations, or scope-of-work development.
  • Experience managing an LMS, retail sales enablement platform, advocacy community, or SaaS provider, including user growth, engagement analytics, and platform optimization.
  • Experience designing, administering, or evaluating retail sales incentive and submit-a-sale programs, including fraud detection, submission validation, and compliance controls.
  • Experience supporting major mobile product launches, retail promotions, and channel marketing initiatives, with the ability to connect field activity to incremental sales and ROI.
  • Experience with business intelligence, dashboarding, data visualization, or reporting tools beyond Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience working in a global or cross-border organization, particularly in partnership with headquarters teams based in Asia.
  • Mandarin Chinese language proficiency.

  • Health & Wellness Days: 10 days per year (prorated based on start date)
  • Paid Holidays: 12 days per year
  • Medical Insurance

title: [SALES] Sales Operations Support Manager
description:
Position Summary:

TCL North America is seeking a Sales Operations Support Manager to provide operational, analytical, and administrative support to the Home Theater, Appliance, and RAC sales teams. This role plays an important part in ensuring the sales organization operates efficiently by maintaining accurate sales and product data, coordinating key business activities, supporting reporting and competitive analysis, and managing day-to-day office operations.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with data, systems, and cross-functional teams. This individual will serve as a key operational resource for the sales organization, helping maintain accurate information, coordinate priorities, and ensure business and office needs are executed effectively. This position is based in TCL's Minneapolis-area office in Hopkins, Minnesota.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Sales Operations & Business Support

  • Provide day-to-day operational support to the Home Theater, Appliance, and RAC sales teams to ensure efficient execution of business processes and priorities.
  • Coordinate sales support activities, track open items, and follow through on deliverables to support timely execution.
  • Maintain organized and accurate business information across internal systems and sales support tools.
  • Partner with Sales and cross-functional teams to address operational needs and support ongoing business initiatives.

Sales Reporting & Data Management

  • Prepare and maintain weekly sales reports, trackers, and other recurring business reporting.
  • Manage data collection, validation, and entry to support accurate and timely sales information.
  • Review data for accuracy, identify discrepancies, and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Support ad hoc reporting and analysis to assist the sales organization with business planning and decision-making.

Retailer & Product Data Management

  • Maintain accurate product information across retailer systems, including product specifications, weights, dimensions, and other required product data.
  • Support product setup and ongoing data maintenance for retail partners including Best Buy, Walmart, Sam's Club, Costco, Amazon, Home Depot, Lowe's, and regional accounts.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to collect and validate required product information and ensure timely retailer submissions.
  • Monitor product data for completeness and accuracy and follow up on outstanding information as needed.

Competitive & Promotional Analysis

  • Conduct research on competitive products, pricing, promotions, and other relevant market activity.
  • Organize and summarize competitive information to support sales planning and customer discussions.
  • Assist with tracking promotional activity and other market developments relevant to TCL's product categories.

Office Operations & Coordination

  • Manage day-to-day operations of the TCL Minneapolis-area office, including office supplies, facilities needs, and coordination of cleaning and other office services.
  • Partner with the TCL IT team to coordinate office technology, equipment, and related support requirements.
  • Coordinate key meetings, internal events, and other office activities as needed.
  • Serve as a point of contact for general office operational needs and help ensure a professional and well-organized workplace.

 

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security. 

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

Working Conditions:

  • This is an on-site position based in TCL's Minneapolis-area office in Hopkins, MN.
  • Typical office environment with regular computer-based work, data entry, reporting, and coordination across multiple teams.
  • May require flexibility to support meetings, events, retailer deadlines, and other time-sensitive business activities.

Cognitive and Physical Demands:

  • Daily: Extended periods of sitting, computer work, data entry, reporting, email communication, and use of business systems.
  • Frequent: Managing multiple priorities and deadlines; reviewing detailed sales and product information for accuracy; communicating and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Occasional: Moving or handling office supplies, materials, or equipment associated with general office operations and meeting/event support.

Qualifications:

Must Have:

  • Relevant experience in sales operations, sales support, business operations, data management, retail support, or a related function.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to organize, analyze, and maintain business and sales data.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and working knowledge of Microsoft Word.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate product, retailer, and sales information.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and recurring responsibilities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across sales and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to receive direction, translate requirements into actionable next steps, and execute with appropriate coaching and feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new systems, tools, and business processes quickly.

  • Operational Efficiency & Cost Control: Identify opportunities to reduce processing errors, streamline workflows, and balance customer service requirements with margin and operational cost objectives.

Operational Reporting, Performance & Business Analysis

  • Forecast & Inventory Analysis: Evaluate demand trends, forecast variances, inventory positions, and supply availability to support planning decisions and identify operational or financial impacts.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Investigate recurring order issues, inventory imbalances, reporting discrepancies, and process inefficiencies; recommend corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Data-Driven Recommendations: Translate operational performance insights into actionable recommendations to improve planning accuracy, inventory efficiency, service levels, and cost control.

  • ERP & Data Integrity: Maintain accurate and consistent information across ERP and other operational systems, resolving data gaps and system discrepancies that affect business execution.
